must: Every UI request uses 21st.dev: search the catalog first (21st search / 21st CLI), reuse frontend/src/components/ui/21st primitives, and only generate with 21st AI when nothing fits.
Install or pull 21st results into the project stack (React + Vite + Tailwind + theme tokens + Phosphor). Do not paste sketch HTML as production code.
New UI surfaces record the 21st references used in .21st/design.json decisions.
avoid: Hand-rolling buttons, inputs, tabs, empty states, cards, or drawers that 21st already covers.
Adding shadcn or extra UI/animation libraries.
Skipping 21st search because a similar component already exists in the repo.

decisions.notes: Manage Documents is a compact dual-pane explorer. Left: source pills + local/cloud tree + compact dropzone. Right: workspace embeddings. Transfer is a circular arrow, not a full-screen stretch.
Skills Marketplace is a searchable card grid with pill category tabs. Create/upload in a modal. Detail drawer for enable, workspace assign, and delete. No extra UI kits.

Tickets is a first-class /tickets surface with Board and Table pill tabs, a right-hand drawer, 21st primitives, and Phosphor icons. No extra UI kits. Start runs the workspace agent with optional tool overrides.

decisions.choice: 21st.dev is the default component source for all UI work
decisions.notes: Search 21st first, reuse installed 21st primitives, generate with 21st AI only if the catalog has no fit. Map everything onto project tokens and Phosphor.

decisions.choice: 21st pixel-grid loader for waiters and chat thinking
decisions.notes: Drive/Dots/Orbit grid with Plus Jakarta shimmer label and tabular elapsed timer. Theme tokens, no shadcn. Used for fullscreen, page, chat generating, CoT, and agent thinking.

decisions.choice: Phosphor Detective header toggle for private chat sessions
decisions.notes: 21st catalog had only generic switches. Incognito is a 35px circular Detective control in the existing chat header cluster, matching ChatSettingsMenu. Session-level: replies stream in-tab and are not written to workspace_chats or agent history.

Company-admin Getting Started on Home. Accordion checklist rebuilt with 21st Button, Field, Dropzone, LoadingState, Phosphor, and theme tokens (sky done-state to match selected controls). No shadcn, base-ui, lucide, or TypeScript. Wires to workspace update/create, invite links, and existing Slack/Teams/Telegram/Drive settings.

decisions.choice: Per-MCP brand mark on marketplace cards
decisions.notes: Every curated MCP has a logo in Skills Marketplace cards, the detail drawer, Connect modal, Agent Skills MCP list, and the workspace skill picker. Brand MCPs use official marks (Slack, YouTube, Postgres, Brave, GitHub, Google). Generic MCPs use compact SVG marks. Unknown servers fall back to the MCP icon. 21st primitives unchanged.

decisions.choice: Server-side content policy, not an @agent skill
decisions.notes: In-app chat and agent prompts are scanned before any model sees them, including private sessions. Admin toggle lives on Settings → Security using the existing Toggle so it matches Multi-User and Password Protection. Blocks write a sanitized event log with no message body. No extra UI kit.
